name: China Panda Garden
notes: No website on record. Own ordering platform (chinapandagarden.netwaiter.com, address-confirmed 1788 E Main St, El Cajon) has no menu published for this location at all - checked live in Chrome, the store page shows Delivery: No and no Menu tab/link, unlike neighboring NetWaiter listings that do show one; this is a real absence, not a closed-store gate (site loaded fine, just has no ordering menu for this restaurant). Used the DoorDash marketplace page instead (address-matched via its own JSON-LD, 1788 E Main St), reading the schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD block server-side (91 items across 11 sections incl. a duplicate Most Ordered section, deduped to 78 unique dishes). Markup test on DoorDash: only 1 of 78 prices has cents at all (the rest are whole dollars), so the standard divisor test is uninformative here (round-dollar prices break the test per prior findings) - recorded as medium rather than high for that reason. Cross-checked against allmenus.com (tier 5, Grubhub family, independent of DoorDash): allmenus prices are substantially lower (.00-5.45 for entrees split across lunch/dinner tiers) than DoorDash's (9-2 for the same category), a persistent gap rather than a single clean ratio. Allmenus carries no visible per-page date; given the repeated pattern in this corpus of allmenus pages running years stale, and that DoorDash's own pricing is internally consistent with no markup signature, DoorDash was used as the primary source and allmenus was NOT used as a corroborating cross-check (the disagreement means they do not agree, so the cross-check field is left empty per the rule that it only records sources that agree on price). zmenu.com 403'd.
